query: INSERT INTO scim_groups (id, org_id, display_name, external_id, members, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, external_id = EXCLUDED.external_id, members = EXCLUDED.members, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scim_groups o WHERE o.org_id = EXCLUDED.org_id AND o.display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name AND o.id <> EXCLUDED.id)
